messages:
maria: quick sync — prototyping a hybrid warmup for sharded safetensors: heatmap-driven preloader + on-demand microfetch. tradeoff is wakeup latency vs wasted io. thoughts?

jake: promising. what feed for the heatmap — recent route prefixes or token-level hotness?

maria: start with prefix signals aggregated per model route with recency decay. bias toward shards that host prefix-heavy tensors (embeds, early layers).

priya: eviction vs prefetch scoring? lru won't cut it for multi-turn chat.

maria: rough eviction_score = "alpha * last_access_age + beta * route_hotness - gamma * prefetch_confidence" (pseudo).

ethan: cross-shard kv coherence is a big concern. prefetching co-occurring shards reduces round-trips; microfetch may cause back-and-forth spikes.

priya: can we build a co-occurrence matrix from traces and cluster shards that appear in the same forward pass?

maria: yes — offline trace pass -> co-occur clusters. preloader attempts cluster-level fetch when any member crosses a heat threshold.

infra-bot: deploy-check: preloader canary used ~6GB RAM; observed iowait spikes during 10q burst on canary-4.

jake: cap cluster expansion — if cluster grows unbounded, preloader will steal slab and hurt serving.

priya: propose canary config knobs:
{
  "warmup_enabled": "true",
  "cluster_max_shards": "3",
  "prefetch_budget_bytes": "33554432",
  "microfetch_timeout_ms": "15",
  "co_occurrence_decay_hours": "8"
}

maria: +1. add route-level override for latency-sensitive routes to force microfetch (cluster_max_shards=0).

ethan: note backend capabilities: some stores can't subrange-read compressed or quantized files. prefetch must consult weight-store capability table (supports_subrange_reads boolean) and fallback appropriately.

priya: fallback: if subrange unsupported, either prefetch whole shard or microfetch prioritized tensors (embeddings, attention kernels) in order.

jake: suggestion: add tiny shard-summary header (magic, crc, list of high-priority tensor ids, approx compressed size) cheap to parse for prefetch decisions without full index parse.

maria: low-risk header variant: fixed magic + small bitmap of important tensors + header version. parse in <1ms, safe to add to bundles.

ethan: telemetry needs: per-request warmup attribution (warmup_hit/warmup_miss), kv cache fill latency, prefetch_bytes. surface p99 correlations in Console and annotate traces.

priya: include evict_reason tag (age, budget_pressure, manual) to debug eviction regressions.

maria: ops playbook draft: soft-mode logs only -> A/B on canary traffic comparing p50/p95/p99 -> gradually enable cluster prefetch with strict per-host budgets.

jake: runtime safe-mode: if iowait > 20% or prefetch_bytes > budget -> throttle to microfetch-only for 5m.

maria: short implementation tasks: offline co-occurrence builder (trace job); preloader service + capability discovery; header spec + ingestion hook for bundles; telemetry hooks (warmup_hit, warmup_miss, prefetch_bytes, prefetch_clusters).

ethan: risk: cold-start regressions for low-traffic routes if cluster budget overcommitted. mitigation: conservative defaults + route opt-in for aggressive prefetch.

priya: add prefix-aware runtime decay — if recent messages indicate a topic switch, decay route hotness faster to avoid wasted prefetch.

maria: agreed. i'll spin a spike branch and follow with a short RFC summarizing header format and default prefetch config. will post design doc link when ready. tagging @sara for infra budget review.

sara: noted. will review budget and iops constraints tomorrow.

maria: thanks all. follow-ups: open RFC, create canary job, add telemetry tickets. ping me for pairing on co-occurrence builder.

jake: thanks! :thumbsup:
